stories.name: Silpa
stories.headline: $200 a year for three years gave Silpa a whole new life.
stories.summary: At eleven, Silpa had dropped out of school to care for her asthmatic mother. Today she's a working nurse who built the first brick home in her village.
stories.outcome: Working nurse · brick home for her mother

stories.name: Pastor Rajesh
stories.headline: "My uncle laughed when I said I wanted to plant a church. Now he prays with us every Sunday."
stories.summary: Rajesh was sponsored through Bible college. He now pastors a 90-member congregation that meets in a rented hall — including the uncle who once mocked him.
